chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. al-Saqr al-Sa'igh narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ayyub narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Musa informed us. He said: Hisham b. Yusuf informed us from Abdullah b. Sulayman al-Nawfali from Muhammad b. Ali b. Abdullah b. Abbas from his father from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
Love Allah for what He nurtures you with of His blessings. Love me for the sake of Allah's love, the Mighty and Majestic. And love my Ahl al-Bayt for the sake of my love.

key_terms.أحبوا الله: Love Allah — the foundational commandment from which all other loves derive
key_terms.أهل بيتي: Ahl al-Bayt (my household) — the Prophet's family, a central concept in Shia Islam
key_terms.نعمه: His blessings — divine favors that motivate gratitude and love

ai.seo_question: Why does the Prophet Muhammad say to love his Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In this famous prophetic tradition narrated through Ibn Abbas, the Prophet (s) establishes a chain of love: love of Allah due to His blessings leads to love of the Prophet for Allah's sake, which in turn requires love of the Ahl al-Bayt for the Prophet's sake. This hadith is significant in Shia theology as it establishes the love of the Prophet's household as an integral extension of loving Allah and His Messenger.
